questions.q: 在交警年終工作會議裡，騎電動車闖紅燈屢勸不改的人會被罰多少錢？
questions.answer: 罚款二十元（首次警告教育）

questions.q: 交警年終會議上，事故科說今年的事故發生率比去年下降了多少？
questions.answer: 下降了百分之七点五

questions.q: 交警會議提到那起雙方都託人關說的事故，重新鑑定後責任比例怎麼劃分？
questions.answer: 一方百分之三十，一方百分之七十

questions.q: 交警會議中安全科提到，法律規定幾歲以下不能騎電動車？
questions.answer: 十六周岁以下

questions.q: 交警會議最後，二大隊說晚上開發區工程車主要有哪些問題要整治？
questions.answer: 超载以及超速，红灯时刹不住车

questions.q: 在那場生活安全知識的討論裡，工地高處作業超過幾米就必須使用安全帶？
安全知識討論會中提到，氣焊作業時乙炔瓶和氧氣瓶之間至少要相距多遠？
questions.answer: 至少五米（气瓶距动火点至少十米）

questions.q: 在安全討論的食品安全部分，熟食在室溫下放超過多久就不該再吃？
questions.answer: 两小时

questions.q: 安全討論會談開車安全時說，塞車時打開頭燈能讓車禍機率減少多少？
questions.answer: 百分之三十二

questions.q: 安全討論會談旅遊安全時，在飯店遇到被偷或被搶應該撥打什麼電話？
在商場經理的部門會議裡，女裝部建議雙十二的滿減活動怎麼設計？
questions.answer: 满二百减二十，另外满三百五赠五十元优惠券

questions.q: 商場會議中，對那件顧客穿一週就起球要退貨的大衣，經理決定怎麼處理？
questions.answer: 先拿回来送厂家鉴定，质量问题就退，不是质量问题就不退

questions.q: 商場會議上，床上用品部提出雙十二要做什麼樣的滿贈活動？
questions.answer: 满五百赠二百、买一千赠五百

questions.q: 在商場會議裡，電子產品部說來看手機的客人以哪個年齡層居多？
questions.answer: 年轻人

questions.q: 商場會議最後經理談手機賣點時，說老人家通常喜歡什麼樣的手機？
questions.answer: 待机时间长的手机

questions.q: 在美容院新店開業的會議裡，建議推出的低價體驗套餐定價多少？
questions.answer: 十九块九（19.9元），每人限用一次

questions.q: 美容院開業會議中，「一天一塊錢」的全年美容活動顧客總共要交多少錢？
questions.answer: 三百六十五元

questions.q: 討論美容院積分制度時，大家定的是消費多少錢積一分？
questions.answer: 十元积一分

questions.q: 美容院會議裡，預存產生的積分和消費產生的積分在有效期上有什麼不同？
questions.answer: 预存积分永久有效，消费积分每年清零

questions.q: 美容院開業會議的後段，建議把廣告和低價套餐主要投放到哪裡？
questions.answer: 网上，主要是美团等平台

questions.q: 在工廠年關安全會議上，生產部認為公司安全管理制度最大的問題是什麼？
questions.answer: 制度只挂在墙上、停留在文字表面，没有切实落实

questions.q: 工廠安全會議宣讀的雙控知識點裡，風險等級分別用哪幾種顏色表示？
questions.answer: 红、橙、黄、蓝四种颜色（重大、较大、一般、低风险）

questions.q: 工廠年關安全會議裡，本單位列出的較大風險作業有哪些？
questions.answer: 五十吨天车吊装作业、双频淬火作业、工频作业、液氮罐

questions.q: 工廠安全會議中，安保部說年底要對進廠人員加強什麼檢查？
questions.answer: 酒后上岗检查，对进场人员做酒精检测

questions.q: 工廠安全會議快結束時，倉庫為了防止年底偷盜申請購置什麼？
questions.answer: 几个监控摄像头

questions.q: 在商場樓層主管的季度早會上，上個季度的銷售為什麼表現不錯？
questions.answer: 疫情过后客流量增加，各部门基本达到销售目标

questions.q: 商場季度會議中，鞋帽部提出消費滿多少錢就送襪子？
questions.answer: 满二百九十九元

questions.q: 商場會議裡童裝部的優惠券要怎麼發放和使用？
questions.answer: 当天消费满200元送20元优惠券，之后任何一天都可抵用

questions.q: 商場會議中，鞋帽部針對夫妻一起進店買鞋設計了什麼優惠？
questions.answer: 买男鞋的话女鞋打八折（一家三口买童鞋也打折）

questions.q: 商場會議最後，主管要求男裝區的商務裝和潮流裝怎麼陳列？
questions.answer: 风格要分开摆放，不要混在一起，门口模特也分开

questions.q: In the remote control design meeting, what technology did the Industrial Designer say most remotes use to send signals to the TV?
questions.answer: Infrared signals.

questions.q: In the remote control design meeting, roughly what wireless range did the Industrial Designer give for the infrared signal?
questions.answer: Up to about five metres.

questions.q: For the remote control project, how many subjects took part in the marketing team's usability lab study?
questions.answer: A hundred subjects.

questions.q: According to the market research presented in the remote control meeting, what share of users find most remote controls ugly?
questions.answer: 75 percent.

questions.q: In the remote control design meeting, why did the project manager say teletext would not be included?
questions.answer: Consumers consider teletext outdated now that there is the internet.

questions.q: In the remote control meeting, what cheaper alternative to speech recognition did the project manager suggest for finding a lost remote?
questions.answer: A button on top of the TV that makes the remote beep so you can find it.

questions.q: In the remote control market research, which age group mostly wanted an LCD display and speech recognition?
questions.answer: The 35 and under age group.

questions.q: In the final remote control design meeting, what type of power source had the team decided to use?
questions.answer: A kinetic charger (kinetic battery).

questions.q: In the remote control prototype presentation, what would the remote say when someone shouts asking where it is?
questions.answer: It would shout back "I'm here".

questions.q: In the remote control prototype, how many circuit boards were needed and why?
questions.answer: Two separate PCBs, because the device is split over two layers joined at the hinge.

questions.q: In the remote control evaluation, what rating scale did the marketing expert use for the criteria?
questions.answer: A seven-point scale where one is true and seven is false.

questions.q: In the remote control prototype evaluation, which criterion got the weakest rating, and what was its average?
questions.answer: Minimising repetitive strain injury (RSI), averaging about 4.25.

questions.q: In the remote control finance discussion, what did the unit cost come to after taking out voice recognition?
questions.answer: About 12.25 euros, within the 12.5 euro budget.

questions.q: In the remote control team's project review, which communication tool did they say they would have used more if they had more time?
questions.answer: The email system.

questions.q: In the remote control design meeting, what situation did the interface designer give to explain why a mute button is useful?
questions.answer: When the viewer gets a telephone call, they can bring the sound down without switching off the TV and keep watching.

questions.q: In the remote control design meeting, what example did the interface designer use for the subtitles button?
questions.answer: Watching a French program and wanting English subtitles.

questions.q: In the remote control design meeting, how many pins did the chip inside the opened-up remote have?
questions.answer: Eighteen pins.

questions.q: In the remote control design meeting, why did the industrial designer say the circuit board is cheap to build?
questions.answer: It is just printed rather than wired, the prints act as wires and circuits, and boards can be built in bulk.

questions.q: In the remote control design meeting, what outdoor temperatures did the industrial designer say the integrated circuit should withstand?
questions.answer: High temperatures like thirty-eight or forty degrees, as well as low temperatures.

questions.q: In the remote control design meeting, how did the marketing expert research what the competition was doing?
questions.answer: By looking at press and ads for other remotes, surfing the internet, and noticing and asking about remotes in people's houses.

questions.q: In the remote control design meeting, what example did the interface designer give of using the voice recognition feature in the morning?
questions.answer: Saying a prerecorded 'good morning' at around eight o'clock makes the TV recognise her voice and switch on to the news.

questions.q: In the remote control conceptual design meeting, what age group of customers is the remote targeted at?
questions.answer: People aged sixty to eighty.

questions.q: In the remote control conceptual design meeting, to which cities did the marketing expert send trend-watchers?
questions.answer: Milan and Paris.

questions.q: In the remote control conceptual design meeting, which two editions did the marketing expert advise bringing out, and for whom?
questions.answer: A wood-like edition for more exclusive, wealthier people and a grey-black edition for people with less means.

questions.q: In the remote control conceptual design meeting, how would the proposed single subtitle button work?
questions.answer: One push gives small subtitles, a double push gives big subtitles for people who can't read small ones.

questions.q: In the remote control conceptual design meeting, how long did the interface designer think one battery would last?
questions.answer: Six months or more, since the small display uses little energy.

questions.q: In the remote control conceptual design meeting, why did the marketing expert advise against speech recognition, and where did he suggest putting it instead?
questions.answer: The survey showed the target group would not pay more for it; it would be better in the other product meant for younger people.

questions.q: In the remote control conceptual design meeting, how did the project manager propose that users find a lost remote?
questions.answer: A button on the docking station that makes the remote start beeping, which is cheaper than voice recognition.
